language.label: Language
language.help: Choose a language. Some pages still use English.

signal.title: RF / Signal
signal.subtitle: Signal strength of packets heard by observers.
signal.error: Could not load signal data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
signal.measurement: Measured by each observer on the last hop. Times are UTC.
signal.window: {{since}} to {{until}} UTC, current hour excluded. Blank hours don't mean an outage.
signal.averagesHelp: Each observation counts equally; missing readings are left out.
signal.binsHelp: Each bin includes its lower bound; the outer bins catch everything beyond.
signal.histogramDescription: {{metric}} distribution in {{unit}}. Exact bin boundaries and counts follow below.
signal.trendDescription: Hourly mean {{metric}} in {{unit}}, UTC. Gaps mean no readings. Exact values are in the hourly table.
signal.coverageDescription: Available and unavailable readings for SNR and RSSI. Exact counts and percentages are in the sample availability table.

paths.subtitle: How received packets carry route hashes.
paths.error: Could not load path data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
paths.countsHelp: Empty paths have no hash width, and unclassified packets had no usable path data.
paths.details: Exact width, path-length and hourly values
paths.lengthsHelp: Zero means an empty path; hours with no data are left as gaps.
paths.widthDescription: Hash-width share among non-empty paths. Exact counts follow below.
paths.coverageDescription: Path type for every observation. Exact counts follow alongside.
paths.lengthDescription: Path entries per observation. Zero means an empty path. Exact counts follow in the table.
paths.trendDescription: Hourly observations with 1, 2 or 3-byte hash paths, UTC. Gaps mean no data. Exact values follow in the hourly table.

traffic.subtitle: When and where observers hear packets.
traffic.error: Could not load traffic. Try refreshing.
traffic.measurement: Counts are observations, not unique packets. Times are UTC; blank hours don't mean an outage.
traffic.groupingHelp: Charts group smaller areas into “Other areas”; this table keeps every area.
traffic.shareDescription: Observation share by area. Exact counts and percentages follow in the table.
traffic.trendDescription: Hourly observations by area. Gaps mean no data. Exact totals follow in the data table.
traffic.heatmapDescription: Activity by UTC day and hour. Brighter cells mean more observations.

scopes.title: Transport scopes
scopes.subtitle: Scope activity for the selected region.
scopes.error: Could not load scopes. Try refreshing.
scopes.measurement: An observer can belong to more than one scope. These counts aren't limited to a time range.
scopes.groupingHelp: Charts show the largest 12 scopes plus any remainder. The table keeps all matching scopes.
scopes.chartDescription: Counts by transport scope. Exact values for all matching scopes are listed in the table.

clockDrift.caption: Repeaters & room servers out of sync · worst first

observerPage.searchHelp: Search by name to find observers outside the first 50 results.
observerPage.empty: No packets heard in this period
observerPage.noTelemetryHelp: This observer sent no device telemetry for this period.

observerCompare.title: Compare observers
observerCompare.invalidObserver: Choose a different observer with a valid identifier.
observerCompare.invalidTime: This comparison time is invalid or too old. Refresh to use the latest complete window.
observerCompare.unavailable: Comparison not available on this server.
observerCompare.currentNote: Totals cover this window; battery, uptime and noise floor are current values.
observerCompare.retention: Only packets the server still keeps are compared.
observerCompare.empty: Neither observer heard a flood packet in this window.
observerCompare.definition: Each flood packet counts once. Not a packet-loss measure.
observerCompare.retainedWindow: Packets are only kept for a few days, so older windows may be incomplete.
observerCompare.overlapShortRanges: Packet overlap is available for 24h and 7d.

investigation.title: Observations
investigation.pathNote: Grouped by the repeaters each copy came through. Short IDs can match more than one node.
investigation.traceNote: TRACE entries show the planned route, not the path the packet took.
investigation.unmappable: Needs at least two repeaters with known locations.
investigation.retention: One entry per observer. Older packets expire after the server's packet retention.
investigation.unavailableReport: That observation is no longer available or the link is invalid. Choose one below.
investigation.mapNote: Lines join repeaters with known locations. They don't prove a direct radio link.
investigation.unavailableMap: This path can't be mapped. Choose another path or All paths.

routeEvidence.missing: Recent observations aren't available for this route on this server.
routeEvidence.error: Could not load recent observations. Try again.
routeEvidence.match: Observations along exactly these hops at {{width}} byte(s) per hop, newest first. TRACE packets aren't included.
routeEvidence.caution: Matching short IDs don't prove the same physical path.
routeEvidence.retention: Older packets drop off; the Heard count above covers the route's whole life.
routeEvidence.unavailable: This route can't be matched against packets.
routeEvidence.empty: No observations on this route are still kept. Older ones may have expired.
